module_summary: 32-bit global branch history shift register: shifts in predictions, and on misprediction reloads from train_history plus actual outcome (priority).

anchors.name: predict_history
anchors.why: History shift register; also the module output.

anchors.name: train_mispredicted
anchors.why: Flush/rollback: selects reload from train_history over prediction shift.

anchors.name: predict_valid
anchors.why: Shift enable: inserts predict_taken at LSB when no misprediction.

anchors.name: predict_taken
anchors.why: Predicted direction bit shifted into history.

anchors.name: train_taken
anchors.why: Actual branch outcome appended to restored history.

groups.name: history_register
groups.description: Shift register with prioritized rollback load and prediction shift.
